attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Determine if corporation must file Colorado corporate tax return. Checks for physical presence or economic nexus (post-Wayfair).

initial_action.action_description: // Initialize Colorado filing requirement check; set result.co_has_nexus = false;

action_details.action_description: // Physical nexus established - filing required; set result.co_has_nexus = true;
// Economic nexus established per Wayfair - filing required; set result.co_has_nexus = true;
// No nexus - no filing required; set result.co_has_nexus = false; set result.co_tax_liability = 0.0;

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Colorado state-specific additions and subtractions to federal taxable income. Colorado generally conforms to federal IRC with some modifications.

initial_action.action_description: // Initialize Colorado income adjustments; set result.co_state_additions = 0.0; set result.co_state_subtractions = 0.0;

action_details.action_comment: Calculate Colorado state additions and subtractions
action_details.action_description: // Calculate Colorado state additions and subtractions; set result.co_state_additions = result.co_us_interest_income; set result.co_state_subtractions = result.co_state_tax_deduction;
action_details.action_postfix: result.co_us_interest_income cvd /result.co_state_additions xdef result.co_state_tax_deduction cvd /result.co_state_subtractions xdef

action_details.action_description: // No nexus - no adjustments; set result.co_state_additions = 0.0; set result.co_state_subtractions = 0.0;

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Colorado corporate income tax. Applies Colorado flat rate (4.55%) to apportioned and adjusted taxable income.

initial_action.action_description: // Initialize Colorado tax calculation; set result.co_taxable_income = 0.0; set result.co_tax_liability = 0.0;

action_details.action_description: // Calculate Colorado taxable income and tax; set result.co_taxable_income = (result.co_apportioned_income + result.co_state_additions - result.co_state_subtractions); set result.co_tax_liability = result.co_taxable_income * result.co_corp_tax_rate - result.co_state_credits; set result.co_refund_or_owed = result.co_estimated_payments - result.co_tax_liability;
action_details.action_postfix: result.co_apportioned_income result.co_state_additions + result.co_state_subtractions - 0.0 f> { result.co_apportioned_income result.co_state_additions + result.co_state_subtractions - } { 0.0 } ifelse cvd /result.co_taxable_income xdef result.co_taxable_income result.co_corp_tax_rate fmul result.co_state_credits - 0.0 f> { result.co_taxable_income result.co_corp_tax_rate fmul result.co_state_credits - } { 0.0 } ifelse cvd /result.co_tax_liability xdef result.co_estimated_payments result.co_tax_liability - cvd /result.co_refund_or_owed xdef

action_details.action_comment: No taxable income - no tax liability
action_details.action_description: // No taxable income - no tax liability; set result.co_taxable_income = 0.0; set result.co_tax_liability = 0.0; set result.co_refund_or_owed = result.co_estimated_payments;
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 cvd /result.co_taxable_income xdef 0.0 cvd /result.co_tax_liability xdef result.co_estimated_payments cvd /result.co_refund_or_owed xdef

action_details.action_description: // No nexus - no tax liability; set result.co_taxable_income = 0.0; set result.co_tax_liability = 0.0; set result.co_refund_or_owed = result.co_estimated_payments;
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 cvd /result.co_taxable_income xdef 0.0 cvd /result.co_tax_liability xdef result.co_estimated_payments cvd /result.co_refund_or_owed xdef
